title: Chapter 2 – Conduct of Players: Mock Exam

questions.text: What is a player forbidden to use during play?

options.text: A scoresheet
Notes, sources of information or advice
A chess clock
A pen or pencil

questions.explanation: As per Article 11.1, during play the players are forbidden to use any notes, sources of information or advice, or analyse on another chessboard.

questions.text: What is the penalty if a player is found to have a mobile phone on their person in the playing venue?

options.text: A warning is issued
Time is added to the opponent's clock
The player shall lose the game; the opponent shall win
The game is restarted

questions.explanation: As per Article 11.2, if it is evident that a player has a mobile phone or electronic device on their person in the playing venue, the player shall lose the game and the opponent shall win (unless competition rules specify a different penalty).

questions.text: Which of the following is considered an infringement under Article 11.3?

options.text: Offering a draw once during the game
Writing moves on the scoresheet
Making unreasonable claims to distract the opponent
Pressing the clock after moving

questions.explanation: As per Article 11.3, it is forbidden to distract or annoy the opponent in any manner, including unreasonable claims, unreasonable draw offers, or introducing noise into the playing area.

questions.text: Can a player leave the playing venue during a game?

options.text: Yes, at any time freely
Yes, but only with permission of the arbiter
No, never under any circumstances
Yes, but only during the opponent's turn

questions.explanation: As per Article 11.5, players may leave the playing venue during the game only with the permission of the arbiter.

questions.text: What can an arbiter do in response to an infringement of the Laws?

options.text: Only issue a verbal warning
Award a draw to both players
Apply penalties including declaring loss of game for the offender
Restart the game from the beginning

questions.explanation: As per Article 11.9, an infringement of the Laws may result in penalties including the loss of the game. The arbiter may impose various penalties such as awarding extra time to the opponent or declaring a loss for the offending player.

questions.text: What is the ONLY permitted use of the scoresheet during a game?

options.text: Recording moves, clock times, draw offers and relevant game data
Writing strategy notes for future moves
Calculating variations for upcoming positions
Any purpose the player chooses

questions.explanation: As per Article 11.1, the scoresheet shall be used only for recording the moves, the times of the clocks, offers of a draw, matters relating to a claim and other relevant data. It cannot be used for notes or calculations.
